hooks.command: bash -c 'payload=$(cat 2>/dev/null || true); [ -n "$payload" ] || exit 0; command -v jq >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; root=$(pwd -P) || exit 0; [ -x "$root/bin/cs-sessionstart-run.sh" ] || exit 0; [ -f "$root/CLAUDE.md" ] || exit 0; [ -f "$root/.claude/settings.json" ] || exit 0; jq -e "any(.hooks.SessionStart[]?.hooks[]?.command?; type == \"string\" and contains(\"cs-sessionstart-run.sh\"))" "$root/.claude/settings.json" >/dev/null 2>&1 || exit 0; . "$root/bin/cs-hook-host-lib.sh" 2>/dev/null || exit 0; cs_hook_payload_is_foreign_host "$payload" && exit 0; printf "%s" "$payload" | "$root/bin/cs-sessionstart-run.sh"'
